description: This file defines an interface for reading share product information within the Fineract platform, including methods to retrieve product data, templates, and parameters.

classes.name: ShareProductReadPlatformService
classes.description: Interface for retrieving share product data, including listing all products, retrieving a single product or template, and getting response data parameters.

methods.name: retrieveAllProducts
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of all share products.

methods.name: retrieveOne
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific share product by its ID, optionally including a template.

methods.name: retrieveTemplate
methods.description: Retrieves a default template structure for share products.

methods.name: getResponseDataParams
methods.description: Returns a set of response data parameters relevant for share products.

methods.name: retrieveAllForLookup
methods.description: Retrieves a collection of all share products for lookup purposes.
